name: Better Stack Free
free_limit: Free personal projects: 10 monitors/heartbeats, one status page, Slack/email alerts; 3 GB logs and 3 GB traces/month retained for 3 days
watch_out: The $0 tier is positioned for personal projects. Also includes 100,000 exceptions, 5,000 session replays and 30 GB metrics allowance; longer retention, higher quotas and paid incident responder seats are separate. Do not assume the Free tier includes unlimited production monitoring or commercial-use rights.
